title: Patroni: re-join a replica
description: Runs `nexus scale-out add postgres --role replica`: starts nexus-patroni on a stopped node; Patroni rejoins via pg_rewind/basebackup and reaches streaming.

observe.what: the stopped pg node rejoins -> streaming. Live: ~4.9s.

whatProves: PatroniAdapter.ScaleOutAddAsync starts the Patroni agent on an unjoined node and waits for streaming (apply-on-demand for a brand-new VM, ADR-0010).
